mainEntity.name: How do I do AI competitor research if I have almost no budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a limited budget, start with one decision and a small evidence set: five relevant competitors, a defined customer segment, recent public pages, and a sample of reviews or discussions. Free research tools can support initial comparisons, while specialized tools are better reserved for recurring SEO, traffic, advertising, or monitoring needs. Key factors include: - decision urgency - data freshness - competitor count - cost of being wrong. Run My AI Business recommends a focused implementation approach: build one assistant or workflow, use it, refine it, and expand. Track what changed because of the research so you can judge its value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose one business decision, compare a small verified set of relevant competitors, and use public websites, reviews, search results, and customer discussions before buying specialist tools. Record sources, dates, assumptions, and the action each finding supports. Upgrade only when recurring research saves meaningful time.
